# Fenris blessing

Effects: Fists +15 | Damage Modifier: Resistant (0.5x) VS Fire

# Introduction

Fenris blessing is a status effects which provides the player with Fire resistance and increases the Fists skill by 15, but does not exceed the skill cap of 100.

## Requirements

The effect is granted by wearing all three pieces of the Fenris armor set.

• Armor Piece: Fenris hood | Base Armor: 10 | Weight: 1.0 | Movement Speed: +3%

• Armor Piece: Fenris coat | Base Armor: 10 | Weight: 10.0 | Movement Speed: +3% | Additional Effects: Resistant (0.5x) VS Frost

• Armor Piece: Fenris leggings | Base Armor: 10 | Weight: 10.0 | Movement Speed: +3%

• Armor Piece: Fenris set | Base Armor: 30 | Weight: 21.0 | Movement Speed: +9% | Additional Effects: + 15 Fists (Skill) Resistant (0.5x) VS Fire
